job.title: Product Manager - Knees - East Coast
job.description:
Product Manager – Knee | Orthopaedics

Sydney preferred | East Coast considered

Ready to take your orthopaedic career in a different direction?

A leading global orthopaedic organisation is looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of a highly regarded knee reconstruction portfolio, with several exciting new product introductions on the horizon.

This isn't just a portfolio-maintenance role. With new products already entering the market and further launches planned, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with surgeons, sales teams and internal stakeholders to help shape strategy, drive adoption and successfully bring new technology to market.

And importantly, you don't necessarily need to be a Product Manager already.

If you're currently working in orthopaedic sales, particularly across knee or joint reconstruction, and have been considering a move into marketing, this could be an excellent next career step.

The opportunity

You'll take ownership across key areas of the primary and revision knee portfolio, combining strategic product management with genuine field and customer engagement.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and project-managing new product introductions
  • Developing portfolio strategy and key commercial messages
  • Working directly with orthopaedic surgeons to understand customer needs and drive adoption
  • Partnering closely with the sales team to translate strategy into field execution
  • Managing portfolio, inventory and asset requirements
  • Working collaboratively with local and global stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial growth across the knee portfolio
  • Helping drive engagement around new products, technologies and clinical solutions

This is not a purely desk-based marketing position. You'll remain closely connected to surgeons, customers and the commercial team, making it particularly attractive to someone who enjoys the customer-facing side of orthopaedics.

Who we're looking for

The ideal candidate would bring both knee reconstruction and product marketing experience, but we recognise that's a relatively rare combination.

Orthopaedic knowledge is the priority.

We'd therefore be interested in speaking with:

  • Existing Product Managers within orthopaedics
  • Knee or joint reconstruction sales professionals looking to transition into marketing
  • Candidates with strong hip/joints experience
  • High-quality candidates from adjacent orthopaedic portfolios such as trauma or sports medicine

You'll need strong communication and influencing skills, commercial awareness and the ability to build credibility with both surgeons and experienced sales professionals.

Most importantly, you'll need the curiosity and learning agility to move beyond your immediate area of expertise and take genuine ownership of a portfolio.

Why consider it?

For someone coming from field sales, this is an opportunity to broaden your career without walking away from orthopaedics, surgeons or the commercial side of the industry.

You'll gain exposure to portfolio strategy, product launches, NPI project management and broader commercial decision-making while being supported by an experienced marketing team.

For an existing Product Manager, the attraction is equally strong: meaningful portfolio ownership, multiple upcoming launches and the opportunity to influence the direction and growth of an important orthopaedic portfolio.

Location: Sydney preferred, although strong candidates elsewhere on the East Coast will be considered.

If you're already in orthopaedics and have wondered what a move into product management could look like, this is a great opportunity to explore it.

Contact Jonathan Gertler at OneMD for a confidential discussion. 0406 423 734

job.title: Territory Manager - Orthopaedic Trauma - Sydney
job.description:
Territory Manager

A long-established medical device organisation with a global reach and a speciality in Orthopaedic Trauma products are adding to their team in Sydney, as they commence a program of growth and implement a new go to market strategy. It's an exciting time to join them!

job.title: State Sales Manager - Joint Replacement - (Adelaide)
job.description:
State Sales Manager – Orthopaedics - Adelaide

An outstanding opportunity has become available to join a globally recognised orthopaedic organisation as State Sales Manager, leading the South Australian business.

This is far more than a sales management position.

It's an opportunity to develop people, influence strategy, strengthen customer partnerships, and play a key role in the continued growth of a market-leading orthopaedic portfolio.

Whether you're already leading a successful sales team or you're a high-performing Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager ready to step into leadership, this role offers the platform to make a genuine impact.

 

About the Role

Reporting to the National Sales Director, you'll be responsible for leading the commercial strategy across South Australia while coaching and developing a high-performing team of Product Specialists.

Success in this role isn't simply measured by revenue growth. It's about creating a culture of accountability, developing future leaders, strengthening key customer relationships, and ensuring your team has the tools, confidence, and capability to consistently deliver exceptional results.

Working closely with Marketing, Clinical Education and the broader leadership team, you'll help shape both regional execution and national strategy.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Lead Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve and exceed business objectives
  • Drive sustainable sales growth and increase market share across Adelaide
  • Analyse sales performance, customer insights and market trends to identify new opportunities
  • Manage regional budgets and business performance
  • Translate national strategies into successful regional execution

 

Develop High Performing People

  • Lead, coach and mentor a team of Product Specialists
  • Conduct regular field coaching and joint customer visits
  • Develop individual capability through structured development plans
  • Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performance culture
  • Recruit, develop and retain top talent

 

Build Strategic Customer Relationships

  • Support your team in developing meaningful partnerships with surgeons, hospital executives and procurement teams
  • Guide strategic account planning across key hospitals
  • Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities that improve clinical and commercial outcomes

 

Collaborate Across the Business

  • Work closely with Marketing, Clinical Education and National Leadership to deliver business objectives
  • Contribute to business planning and strategic initiatives
  • Champion best practice and continuous improvement across the wider sales organisation

 

About You

You'll be an inspiring leader with a passion for developing people and driving commercial success.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Orthopaedic medical device sales experience
  • Previous leadership experience or a proven track record as a Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager ready to step into management
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience developing strategic account plans
  • Excellent coaching, mentoring and people development skills
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • A collaborative leadership style with a genuine passion for helping others succeed
  • Degree qualified in Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline (preferred)

 

Why Join?

  • Join a globally recognised leader in orthopaedic medical technology
  • Lead an established, high-performing team with significant growth opportunities
  • Work alongside an experienced and supportive national leadership team
  • Influence strategy while remaining closely connected to customers and your team
  • Access ongoing leadership development and long-term career progression
  • Competitive salary package, performance incentives, vehicle allowance and comprehensive employee benefits

 

Who This Role Would Suit

This opportunity is ideal for:

  • A current State or Regional Sales Manager looking to join a global market leader.
  • A high-performing Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager who has demonstrated leadership capability and is ready to take the next step.
  • A people-first sales leader who enjoys coaching, mentoring and building high-performing teams as much as delivering commercial results.

 

If you're looking for an opportunity to lead from the front, develop exceptional people, and influence the future growth of a leading orthopaedic business, it would be great to connect with you. jonathan.gertler@onemd.com.au / 0406 423 734

job.title: Territory Manager - Joint Replacement - Melbourne
job.description:
Territory Sales Manager – Orthopaedics - Melbourne

 

Join a Specialist Orthopaedic Manufacturer with an Outstanding Clinical Reputation

An exciting opportunity has become available to join a highly respected orthopaedic manufacturer that has built its reputation on clinical excellence rather than portfolio size.

 

With a focused range of orthopaedic implant solutions supported by outstanding long-term clinical data, this business has earned the trust of surgeons by consistently delivering quality, innovation, and exceptional patient outcomes.

 

As the business continues to grow across Australia, they are seeking an experienced Territory Sales Manager to drive market expansion, strengthen surgeon relationships, and support the continued adoption of their specialist orthopaedic portfolio.

 

About the Role

Reporting into the Sales Director, you'll take ownership of your territory, driving commercial growth through strategic account management, business development, and outstanding clinical support.

Working closely with a Business Development Manager, you'll create a unified approach to customer engagement while providing hands-on operating theatre support and delivering exceptional service to surgeons and hospital stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced orthopaedic sales professional who enjoys building long-term partnerships and representing products backed by outstanding clinical evidence.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Achieve and exceed territory sales and growth objectives
  • Develop new business opportunities while growing existing surgeon relationships
  • Increase utilisation of a specialist orthopaedic implant portfolio
  • Deliver high-quality in-theatre clinical support and product expertise
  • Build trusted relationships with surgeons, theatre staff, procurement teams, and hospital executives
  • Work collaboratively with Business Development, Clinical Education, Operations, and Customer Service teams
  • Maintain accurate CRM activity, forecasting, and pipeline management
  • Deliver educational presentations and product training to healthcare professionals
  • Monitor market activity and provide commercial insights to support business strategy

 

About You

You'll be an ambitious and commercially driven medical device professional who enjoys working closely with surgeons and thrives in a theatre-based environment.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • A proactive, organised, and accountable approach to territory management
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline and forecasting
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Science, Healthcare, or a related discipline

Existing relationships within the Australian orthopaedic market will be highly regarded.

 

Why Join?

  • Represent a specialist orthopaedic manufacturer renowned for exceptional clinical outcomes
  • Sell products supported by excellent long-term clinical evidence and surgeon confidence
  • Join a growing organisation where your contribution has genuine impact
  • Work within an agile business that values collaboration, innovation, and customer partnerships
  • Build lasting relationships with leading orthopaedic surgeons across your territory
  • Competitive salary package with performance incentives, vehicle allowance, and career development opportunities

 

This Opportunity Is Ideal For

  • An experienced Orthopaedic Territory Manager looking for greater ownership and autonomy.
  • A high-performing medical device sales professional wanting to represent a focused, premium portfolio rather than a broad product range.
  • Someone who values quality, clinical credibility, and building long-term surgeon partnerships over transactional selling.

 

If you're passionate about orthopaedics and want to represent products that genuinely make a difference to patient outcomes, please reach out to Jonathan Gertler 0406 423 734

job.title: Business Development Manager - Orthopaedics - Sydney
job.description:
Business Development Manager – Orthopaedics

📍 Sydney | Full-Time

Take the Lead with a Specialist Orthopaedic Manufacturer

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in the growth of an innovative orthopaedic business?

We're partnering with a highly respected specialist orthopaedic manufacturer renowned for its focused implant portfolio, outstanding long-term clinical outcomes, and strong surgeon loyalty.

Unlike larger organisations with broad product portfolios, this business has built its reputation on delivering clinically proven solutions backed by exceptional evidence, allowing its commercial team to have meaningful conversations centred on patient outcomes rather than simply product breadth.

As the business continues to expand across Australia, we're seeking an ambitious Business Development Manager to drive growth, build strategic surgeon partnerships, and help shape the future direction of the organisation.

About the Opportunity

Reporting directly to the Sales Director, you'll lead all commercial activity within your state, taking ownership of business development, strategic account growth, and customer engagement.

You'll work closely with surgeons, procurement teams, hospital executives, and internal stakeholders to expand market share while mentoring and developing Territory Sales Managers and supporting a network of distributor partners.

As a member of the ANZ Leadership Team, you'll contribute to national commercial strategy and have genuine influence over the future growth of the business.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Territory Manager looking to step into leadership or an established Business Development Manager seeking greater influence within a growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Commercial Growth

  • Own and deliver the state's annual sales and growth objectives
  • Identify and convert new business opportunities across public and private hospitals
  • Increase market share and utilisation of a premium orthopaedic implant portfolio
  • Develop long-term partnerships with surgeons and key hospital stakeholders
  • Prepare commercial proposals, tenders, and pricing submissions

Lead & Develop People

  • Coach and mentor Territory Sales Managers to maximise commercial performance
  • Conduct joint customer visits and field coaching
  • Develop product knowledge, commercial capability, and theatre performance
  • Support and manage distributor and agent performance across the state

Strategic Leadership

  • Contribute to ANZ commercial planning as part of the Senior Leadership Team
  • Provide market intelligence, forecasting, and strategic insights
  • Collaborate with global colleagues on product strategy and business improvement initiatives
  • Partner with Operations, Clinical Education, and Customer Service to deliver an exceptional customer experience

Customer Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with surgeons, theatre teams, procurement, and hospital executives
  • Provide clinical support during key procedures where required
  • Deliver educational programs and support the successful introduction of new technologies
About You

You'll be a commercially driven leader who enjoys winning new business, building strong customer relationships, and helping others succeed.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven success within orthopaedic or medical device sales
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience managing a high-performing territory
  • Experience coaching or mentoring sales professionals
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Strong understanding of orthopaedic implant systems and the hospital environment
  • Experience with CRM systems and sales forecasting
  • Existing relationships within the Australian orthopaedic market highly regarded
  • Experience working with distributors or agents will be advantageous
Why Join?
  • Join a specialist orthopaedic manufacturer recognised for outstanding clinical outcomes and surgeon confidence
  • Represent a focused portfolio supported by exceptional long-term clinical data
  • Be part of an agile organisation where your ideas influence business direction
  • Genuine opportunity to shape commercial strategy as a member of the ANZ Leadership Team
  • Work closely with an experienced and collaborative leadership group
  • Strong career progression opportunities as the business continues to grow
  • Competitive salary package, uncapped bonus, vehicle allowance, and executive benefits
This Role Is Perfect For
  • A high-performing Orthopaedic Territory Manager ready to step into a broader commercial leadership role.
  • An experienced Business Development Manager looking to join a growing specialist manufacturer.
  • A sales leader who enjoys developing people, building surgeon relationships, and driving long-term business growth.

If you're looking to join a business where innovation, clinical credibility, and entrepreneurial thinking are genuinely valued, reach out to Jonathan Gertler for more info 0406 423 734.
